verdict.rationale: The pack shows Persona publishes an API reference (docs.withpersona.com/api-reference) with per-resource pages, an llms.txt, and a sandbox for testing. None of it mentions an interactive explorer, a 'try it' console, or runnable request examples inside the reference. Static reference pages and a separate sandbox environment are adjacent capabilities, not the interactive, runnable API reference this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
